title: Measurement
description: Time series measured on a physical build (or synthetic data, marked as such) under stated conditions.

x-doc.zh: 测量的名字（显示用的标签）
x-doc.en: Name of the measurement (a display label)

x-doc.zh: 测量时设计的名字（只是显示用的快照）
x-doc.en: The design's name at measurement time (a display snapshot only)

synthetic.description: true if generated by a simulator rather than measured

channels.description: equal-length arrays; t (s) is required. psi = crank rotation in the walking direction (rad), torque in N·m, x = body forward position (m).

provenance.description: Where the numbers came from: the test rig (with its calibration) or another source.

quality.description: Automatic checks computed when the raw data were converted. Warnings are for a human to read before trusting a fit.

speed_cv.description: std/mean of crank speed over 0.1 s windows

time_offset_s.description: offset applied when aligning video tracking to the encoder clock

x-doc.zh: 旧名字或旧 ID；指向它们的引用都解析到这个资产
x-doc.en: Former names or ids; a reference to any of them resolves to this asset

x-doc.zh: 稳定的资产 ID（ULID，26 个字符，按创建时间可排序）
x-doc.en: Stable asset id (ULID: 26 characters, sortable by creation time)
